intents_zh: compose 服務貼 traefik 標籤
code:
services:
  {{service_name}}:
    image: nginx:alpine
    labels:
      - 'traefik.enable=true'
      - 'traefik.http.routers.{{service_name}}.rule=Host(`{{host}}`)'
      - 'traefik.http.routers.{{service_name}}.entrypoints=websecure'
      - 'traefik.http.routers.{{service_name}}.tls.certresolver=le'
      - 'traefik.http.services.{{service_name}}.loadbalancer.server.port={{port}}'
    networks: [web]
networks:
  web:
    external: true
summary_zh: docker compose 用 traefik label 自動掛域名與 LE
